courses.title: Advanced Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) & Data Assimilation
courses.description: Master modern atmospheric dynamics, grid generation, parameterizations, WRF/GFS model physics, ensemble prediction systems (EPS), and 3D/4D-Var data assimilation for operational weather forecasting in India.

materials.title: Lecture 1: Primitive Equations in Sigma Coordinates
Study Guide: Boundary Layer Parameterization Notes
Lab Manual: Configuring WRF Preprocessing System (WPS)

subjects.name: Subject 2: Data Assimilation & Satellite Radiance Ingestion

materials.title: Lecture 3: Assimilating INSAT-3DR and Doppler Radar Reflectivity
Slide Deck: Background Error Covariance (B-Matrix) Estimation

courses.title: Doppler Weather Radar (DWR) Operational Data Interpretation & Nowcasting
courses.description: Hands-on operational capacity building on dual-polarization S/C/X band Doppler weather radars. Covers reflectivity (Z), radial velocity (V), differential reflectivity (ZDR), KDP, and convective cell tracking.

subjects.name: Subject 1: Radar Hardware, Scan Strategies & Base Products

modules.title: Module 1: PPI, RHI, MAX(Z) and Radial Velocity De-aliasing

materials.title: DWR Product Atlas (CAPPI, PACP, SRI, ETOP)

courses.title: Tropical Cyclone Forecasting, Track Prediction & Storm Surge Modeling
courses.description: Comprehensive training on Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea cyclone genesis, intensification, track prediction using multi-model ensemble approach, storm surge modeling using ADCIRC and post-landfall impact assessment.

modules.title: Module 1: Genesis Potential Index & Warm Core Structure

materials.title: Lecture: Carnot Heat Engine Model of Tropical Cyclones

courses.title: INSAT-3DR & INSAT-3DS Satellite Meteorology & Product Interpretation
courses.description: Complete guide to INSAT-3DR & 3DS geostationary satellite products — visible (VIS), infrared (TIR), water vapour (WV), shortwave IR (SWIR), sounder temperature-humidity profiles, cloud properties, SST and OLR.

subjects.name: Subject 1: INSAT-3DR Imager Channels & Cloud Classification

courses.title: Agromet Advisory Services & Crop Weather Modeling for Indian Agriculture
courses.description: Training on Block-Level Agromet Advisory Services (FASAL, MEGHDOOT App), district-level weather bulletins, crop-specific heat unit accumulation models, drought monitoring using SPI/PDSI and crop yield forecasting.

courses.title: Indian Summer Monsoon Dynamics, Climate Variability & Long-Range Forecasting
courses.description: In-depth study of Indian Summer Monsoon (ISM) onset, active/break cycles, inter-annual variability driven by ENSO/IOD/MJO teleconnections, CMIP6 model projections for India, and operational long-range seasonal forecast (LRF) methodology.

modules.title: Module 1: ISM Onset & Low Pressure Systems

materials.title: Lecture: Heat Low over Thar Desert

courses.title: Hydrometeorology, Flash Flood Guidance (FFGS) & Quantitative Precipitation Estimation
courses.description: Operational training on South Asia Flash Flood Guidance System (FFGS), river basin QPE, radar-gauge merging, and urban inundation modeling.

materials.title: Video Lecture: Module 1: FFGS Catchment Runoff Modeling

courses.title: Aviation Meteorological Forecasting, Terminal Aerodrome Forecasts (TAF) & Severe Hazards
courses.description: ICAO/WMO compliant training on METAR observation, TAF coding, SIGMET generation, Low-Level Wind Shear (LLWS) detection, and fog nowcasting.

materials.title: Video Lecture: Module 1: TAF / SIGMET Regulatory Standards
